arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Gannon argued the Patent Office reasonably uses its longstanding approach.
Mr. Beeney argued the broadest reasonable interpretation harms patent holders.
Justice Breyer asked whether the interpretation determines patentability directly.
Justice Alito asked if the Board must stick to its initial interpretation.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on how the Patent Trial and Appeal Board interprets patent claims during inter partes review. Cuozzo Speed Technologies seeks a standard aligned with district courts. The government defends the Board's existing approach.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Patent holders face different interpretation standards in administrative and judicial forums. This inconsistency creates uncertainty in patent enforcement. The outcome shapes the balance between administrative efficiency and legal consistency.
